body:
## [3.92.0] - 2026-10-05

### Features

- enhance grass product name handling in cart and checkout processes
- update schema version to 111 and add grass product fields
- enhance OdooApiException handling and add tests for barcode validation
- Enhance cash refund adjustment formatting for Hebrew locale and update related tests
- Implement cash refund adjustment formatting and update related logic across various components
- add test for variant additional barcode selecting its owner
- add support for additional barcodes in product entries and tests
- implement barcode resolution and variant selection logic
- add support for additional barcodes in product DTO and related functionality
- Add comprehensive cash rounding test scenarios for refunds and discounts
- Add message for mixed sale and return items in cash rounding logic
- Update cash refund rounding messages for clarity and consistency
- Enhance cash rounding logic to handle overpayments for change
- Enhance cash rounding functionality and localization
- Implement customer cash rounding for refunds and discounts
- Enhance customer cash rounding functionality
- Implement customer cash rounding feature

### Bug Fixes

- update schema version to 113 and handle missing grass columns
- retry drawer recovery after summary failures
- restore cash drawer safety on resume
- use shared Odoo history for original and copy labels
- default paper on and preserve expiry and original labels
- address settings sync and copy delivery review
- hide deposit prompts when not configured
- complete closed POS phone layouts
- keep closed POS controls safe on phones
- show status footer on Shufersal closed screen
- expose updates in compact status footer
- expose updates while POS is closed
- show deposits separately in cash reports
- exclude standalone negative products from promotion snapshots
- persist negative product identity before order upload
- resolve legacy product IDs before negative-line classification
- preserve negative voucher product lines in invoice copies
- sync fuel device settings to odoo
- surface cash deposit backend errors
- persist cash drawer safety settings
- show cash drawer alerts on phone POS
- repair cash drawer POS validation
- use journal cash for drawer safety
- recover cash drawer safety for open sessions
- address cash drawer safety edge cases
- harden cash drawer safety reminders
- address cash drawer safety review

### Other Changes

- pin backend validation dependencies
- pin backend CI correction
- Control voucher delivery, persist receipt settings and prevent duplicate prints
- Fixed. Grass availability is checked before the first committed payment. After a partial payment is recorded, subsequent tenders skip the recheck so checkout can continue.
- Fixed: all measured grass cuts now stay separate in refunds, even with identical widths and prices.
- Fixed the startup code causing the SQLite lock. - Current financial-protection triggers are no longer recreated on every open. - Fingerprint cleanup writes run only when needed. - Older databases still receive necessary repairs.
- Checkout was waiting on Flutter’s simulated event loop while the test waited only in real time. The test now advances both correctly.
- Fixed. find.byType(FilledButton) missed the internal widget created by FilledButton.icon.
- update cash drawer API submodule
- update cash drawer API submodule
- Refund adjustment now shows −₪0.50. Payment-method amounts show ₪477.00 without a minus when the order ends in a refund. Totals and VAT keep their accounting signs.
- Add launch configuration for VSCode and update subproject commit reference
- Implemented. Flutter now checks the whole basket’s grass cuts before payment. - Missing or insufficient rolls → blocks payment with an explanation. - Cannot reach Odoo → blocks grass checkout and asks to retry. - GRASS_IGNORE_STOCK = True → server allows sales without rolls. - Ordinary products and refunds keep their existing behavior.
- Fixed. General fixed-amount discounts now reduce both net and VAT proportionally, including when combined with cash rounding.
- Grass length entry with automatic length × width = m² pricing. Separate cuts, dimension editing, and quotation support. Measurements preserved through offline storage, checkout, sync, and refunds. Backend validation and roll deduction when the addon enables stock tracking.
- Fixed: the cash discount reduced net sales but left VAT unchanged.
- Found and fixed: closing the cash popup left Credit Card selected internally. Its limit rejected 645 because it exceeded ₪643.20, leaving 64. Cash now stays selected after dismissing the popup, allowing the full 645 without adding a payment or approving rounding.
- Improve cash deposit screen responsiveness
- Keep cash drawer safety refresh current
- Refresh cash drawer safety after checkout
- Add cash drawer safety deposit flow
